title: L1000PAI: Direction-Aware Perturbation Activity Inference from Ranked Transcriptomic Signatures
description: R package for direction-aware perturbation activity inference from ranked transcriptomic signatures using paired Up/Down L1000 signature libraries, with inspectable reports and versioned compound annotations. Package code is MIT-licensed; bundled derived annotation tables have separate data licenses, including CC BY-SA 4.0 for taxonomy 3.0.1, documented in inst/extdata/annotation_catalogs/v3/LICENSE_DATA.md. The L1000 signature libraries are not included; they are downloaded and verified by the companion package L1000PAIdata. Inferred transcriptional resemblance is not by itself direct target engagement or demonstrated clinical efficacy.
